title: perilla frutescens
intro: Perilla frutescens, commonly known as shiso or Japanese basil, is a perennial plant native to East Asia and is a member of the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Perilla frutescens include its ability to inhibit histamine release, exhibit anti-anxiety effects, and show potential in treating cancer. The bioactive constituents of Perilla frutescens include limonene, rosmarinic acid, and perillaldehyde, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
